Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 39

“...why should we not know enough to turn back from this sin, Janardana — we who do see the wrong in destroying a family?”

The argument lands. Knowledge, for Arjuna, is not neutral; if you can see the harm and the other side cannot, the responsibility for stopping falls entirely on you.
